definitions.short: a seer (as often rendered); but also (abstractly) a vision
definitions.full: H7203. ro 'eh I. רֹאֶה noun [masculine] seer , with article ׳הָר (except 2Sam 15:27 ); — old name for נָבִיא 1Sam 9:9 b, used of Samuel 9:9 a.; 9:11 ; 9:18 ; 9:19 and (as archaism) 1Chr 9:22 ; 26:28 ; 29:29 ; of חֲנָנִי 2Chr 16:7 , 10 ; הֲרוֺאֶה apparently of Zadok 2Sam 15:27 , but corrupt (conjecture in We Dr); plural (with preposition) לָרֹאִים Isa 30:10 the seers , as a class. II. רֹאֶה noun [masculine] prophetic vision בָּר ׳שָׁגוּ Isa 28:7 they reel in (their) vision (|| מְּלִילִיָּת מָּקוּ ).
